setup.zh: 城东客栈。胖掌柜压低了声音：十月十八，河伯娶妇——今年的媳妇，是城西卖豆腐的老胡家的哑女。
setup.en: An inn on the east side. The fat innkeeper drops his voice: on the eighteenth of the tenth month the River Lord takes a bride — this year it is Old Hu's mute daughter, who sells tofu on the west side.

recap.zh: 邺城年年给河伯娶妇；你使了两条计——给三老送钱、扮鬼吓巫祝——都没成。
recap.en: Every year Ye gives the River Lord a bride; you tried two plans — money for the Three Elders, a ghost to scare the shaman — and neither worked.

zh: 一碗面汤，清得照得见人影。
en: A bowl of noodle broth, clear enough to see your face in.
"The River Lord wants a person, not tofu."

story.zh:
原来邺城这个规矩，已有二十年了。

掌柜道：「……那姑娘就给打扮起来，坐进木船，推到漳水当中去。一开始，船还漂着。漂着漂着，就沉了。」

小满问道：「今年的媳妇，是谁？」

「三老说，河伯要的是人，不是豆腐。」
story.en:
This custom of Ye's, it turned out, was twenty years old.

The innkeeper said: "…Then the girl is dressed up, sat in a wooden boat, and pushed out into the middle of the Zhang. At first the boat floats. It floats, and floats, and then it sinks."

Xiaoman asked: "And this year's bride — who is she?"

"The Three Elders said the River Lord wants a person, not tofu."

exits.means: tries to buy off the three elders with money

story.zh:
第二天一早，三人去见三老。

胖老头拿指甲拨了拨银子，这才抬起眼皮，道：「小哥有什么事？」

小满一愣：「钱收了，人照放？」胖老头道：「茶水钱是茶水钱。河伯娶亲是河伯娶亲。两码事。」

聋老头这时总算听见了一句，扯着嗓子，声如洪钟：「几两？人家一年给十锭——」

小满道：「那就是说……河伯娶媳妇这门亲事，是有人花钱买下的？」周衡没有答话。阿禾在旁边，把这个圈也照样画进了她的小本子里。
story.en:
Early next morning the three of them went to see the Three Elders.

The fat old man flicked the silver with a fingernail and only then raised his eyelids: "What can we do for you, young man?"

Xiaoman was taken aback: "You take the money and still put her in?" The fat old man said: "Tea money is tea money. The River Lord's wedding is the River Lord's wedding. Two different things."

The deaf old man finally caught a word, and bellowed like a bell: "A few taels? They pay ten ingots a year—"

Xiaoman said: "So… this River Lord's wedding is something somebody bought?" Zhou Heng did not answer. Beside them, A-He drew the same circle into her little notebook.

label.en: Put a bedsheet on and play ghost

exits.means: the bedsheet ghost at the shrine: overhears the white-robed 「仙长」 paying the shaman and knows the voice — the one that called 「回来」 on Black Pine Ridge

story.zh:
头一条计不成，小满便使第二条。

那天夜里，他从客栈的床上扯下一条白床单，往头上一蒙，只露出两只眼睛，对着铜镜一照，飘飘荡荡，颇有几分鬼气。

说话的是巫祝。她跪在地上，一身红衣裳都跪皱了，额头贴着青砖，声音抖得厉害：「……仙长放心，十八那天，照旧。」

他的声音不高，却又冷又沉，像一口老井，井底下冒上来一口凉气。

这个嗓子，他听过。两年前，黑松岭，暴雨前头那一阵，林子深处有人喊：「……回来……」喊了三声，慢慢的，沉沉的，一声比一声远。

那孩子没回来。喊他的人，站在这里。

小满把嗓子压得又粗又哑，道：「……我乃河伯大人座下……巡河夜叉……河伯大人有话……今年，不娶了……」

「沈小满。」

他浑身一僵。回头一看，庙门口站着一个人，红鼻头，手里提着一盏灯笼，正是阿禾。阿禾瞧着他，面无表情地道：「客栈的床单。掌柜的说少了一条，三十文。周师兄让你赔。」

小满落下地来，一把扯下床单，拉起阿禾便跑，一口气跑出了三条街，才敢停下来喘气。
story.en:
The first plan failed, so Xiaoman tried the second.

That night he pulled a white sheet off the inn bed, threw it over his head with only his two eyes showing, and looked in the bronze mirror: floating, drifting, fairly ghostly.

The speaker was the shaman. She was on her knees, her red clothes creased from kneeling, her forehead on the grey brick, her voice shaking badly: "…Rest easy, Immortal Master — on the eighteenth, as always."

His voice was not loud, but cold and heavy, like an old well breathing up a draught of chill from its bottom.

He had heard that voice. Two years ago, on Black Pine Ridge, just before the storm broke, someone deep in the woods had called: "…Come back…" Three times, slow and heavy, each one farther off.

That child never came back. The man who called him was standing here.

Xiaoman made his voice rough and hoarse: "…I am the River Lord's… river-patrolling yaksha… the River Lord says… this year, no bride…"

"Shen Xiaoman."

He went rigid. Turning, he saw someone at the temple door with a red nose and a lantern — A-He. She looked at him with no expression at all: "The inn's sheet. The innkeeper says one's missing — thirty coppers. Brother Zhou says you pay."

Xiaoman dropped to the floor, tore off the sheet, grabbed A-He and ran, three streets at a stretch before he dared stop for breath.

exits.means: goes to the river on the wedding day

story.zh:
手边能算的，只有一笔：明天午时，豆腐西施要坐进那只凿了洞的木船里去。

巫祝说，她跟河伯说得上话。三老说，他们是替河伯办事的。好。那便让她去说，让他们去办。
story.en:
There was only one sum he could do with what he had: at noon tomorrow, the Tofu Beauty would sit down in that holed wooden boat.

The shaman said she could talk to the River Lord. The Three Elders said they did the River Lord's business. Fine. Then let her go and talk, and let them go and do business.

exits.means: goes shopping, asks about the market, wants to buy or sell

text.zh: 东街的坊市摆到城根，可家家户户关着门。
text.en: East Street's market runs to the wall, but every door is shut.

exits.means: asks about the bride, the tofu girl, or goes to see her

story.zh:
她坐在门槛上磨豆子。石磨一圈一圈地转，豆浆一点一点流下来，流进底下的木桶里。她磨得很慢，很仔细，倒像在磨一件要磨上一辈子的东西。

**爹，一个人，磨不动。**
story.en:
She sat on the doorstep grinding beans. The millstone went round and round, the soy milk trickled down into the wooden bucket beneath. She ground very slowly, very carefully, as if grinding something that would take a lifetime.

**Father, alone, can't turn it.**
